title: Cardiovascular Disease in South Asians
subtitle: What cardiovascular disease in South Asians is, causes, risk factors, symptoms, evaluation, management, lifestyle considerations, and safety.
evidence_strength: Established evidence for elevated CVD risk in South Asians is supported by multiple large cohort studies; emerging evidence informs tailored management strategies; moderate evidence for some metabolic and genetic contributors; ongoing research addresses gaps particularly in interventional outcomes within this population.
review_status: AI draft - scientific, clinical, and editorial review required
